The '''Yoggoy system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was home to the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] nest of [[Yoggoy (Hive)|Yoggoy]].

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], Captain [[Jae Juun|Juun]] took [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Saba Sebatyne]] there in a search for a group of Jedi Knights, including [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], [[Zekk]], [[Tahiri Veila|Tahiri]], [[Tekli]], [[Lowbacca]], [[Alema Rar]], and [[Tesar Sebatyne]].
